theorems.name: Submission.bf_compact_projection_null
theorems.statement: (∀ (N m k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, μHE[k] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ g y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, g y ≤ ((C * L ^ m : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[m + k] A) → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < ℓ → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact A → PurelyUnrectifiable n A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ForAlmostAllProjections (n + ℓ) n (fun p ↦ μHE[n] (p '' A) = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
